email.body1:
Candice, saw Alogent's Unify get shortlisted for Best PayTech Solution at the Banking Tech Awards USA 2026, plus three PayTech finalist nods.

Award momentum usually surfaces more in-market banks and credit unions than ops can route to reps fast, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Alogent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Candice, quick follow-up for Alogent.

Most RevOps teams know the data is dirty and the follow-up is late, but can't quantify what that costs in booked meetings. The fix is rarely more reps, it is closing the gap between a signal firing and a personalized touch going out.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and 3 things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Candice, last bit of proof for Alogent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alogent's reply rate likely compares to peer fintech teams. Want to grab a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Candice, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Awards season pulls ops in a dozen directions, and timing matters more than the pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Alogent either way.
